# Task Manager - To-Do Application

A responsive and dynamic Task Manager built with pure JavaScript (DOM Manipulation) to help users organize daily tasks efficiently.

## Features

* **Add Tasks:** Quickly add new tasks with automatically generated creation timestamps.
* **Dynamic Counters:** Real-time tracking of pending and completed tasks.
* **Task Management:** Move tasks seamlessly between waiting and completed states.
* **Edit & Delete:** Update task descriptions on the fly or remove completed/unneeded items.

## Technologies Used

* **HTML5** - Page structure and semantically organized layout
* **CSS3** - Custom styling and layout design
* **JavaScript (ES6+)** - Dynamic DOM manipulation and event handlers
* **Font Awesome** - Clean UI icons for interactive buttons
